# SunRaysEffect

- Inherits [`PostEffect`](posteffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("SunRaysEffect")`

Draws shafts of light that stream from the sun past whatever is in front of it. The shafts come from the open sky around the sun, so a tree or a wall interrupts them. They fade as the sun leaves the view or sets.

When several apply, the first enabled one is used: the children of `Lighting` are considered first, then the camera's. It is not drawn on a machine whose graphics settings turn sun rays off.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Intensity` | `number` | `0.25` | read/write | The brightness of the shafts, from 0 to 1. |
| `Spread` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | How far the shafts extend from the sun, from 0 (a halo) to 1 (across the screen). |
